_doc: Engine release history — the source of truth for what users can fetch. Each entry: version, date, files (name -> sha256), artifactFormat (v1 = carved minified js; v2 = sealed binary), notes. Hashes here must match shim/lib/versions.mjs for the pinned version.

releases.notes: First real engine release. Local runtime + guided init + sync/go-live cloud handshake + additive promote ceremony + feedback command. Carved: internal plane, platform billing, prod adapters absent (CARVE-BOUNDARY marker-scan green at dev repo d3bf317).

AGENT-EOF wave: init on a pipe hands off to a human (exit 0) instead of crashing; every interview prompt EOF-safe; unknown commands exit 1; project-less collections says init-first. Shim 0.1.1 alongside: Node>=18 guard + ESM cache marker (kills the reparse warning). Built from dev repo 9f82d94, gate 226+31+12 green.

Message-truth wave. 0.1.1's agent handoff named gemmein/llms.txt — a path nothing creates, in an order that couldn't work; it now points at `gemmein dev` then http://127.0.0.1:4545/llms.txt. One project gate at dispatch, so `rules` and `check` stop answering as if a project existed. SHAPE-1 learning accepts pk_local_ as well as pk_test — local dev never learned shapes at all (ledger #72, cause corrected). init requires a real owner email; a busy port says so instead of dying silently. Built from dev repo 1f743f8, gate 227+31+15 green.

W3.1 sealed files — the local runtime speaks the ref contract prod ships: upload() returns ref not url, /files/{ref}/link mints delivery, the local DevKeySigner signs sealed links with the same canned-policy bytes as CloudFront (parity law, no if(isDev) in the gate). BREAKING with sdk<0.3.0 teaching; pairs with @gemmein/sdk 0.3.0. llms.txt guide updated to the ref contract AND gains the entitlements teaching: Paid ACCESS bullet (requires/grants/union/entitlement_required/purchases.mine) + Selling THINGS rewritten to the W2.5b commercial record, optional receipts, sealed-file delivery and the digital-only scope (first llms change since 0.1.0). Built from dev repo a8c477b, verify gate green (security:static + tests + apps + package), ledger 92 affirmed 0 drift.

W4 wave into the local runtime: purchases.mine() carries delivery for downloadable products (the __product_files system collection, purchase-authorized short-lived links, wider product MIME profile, 100MB cap); the byte meter with per-person ceilings and floors; the dev file sink answers browsers from any origin and refuses oversize loudly (413) instead of truncating silently. llms.txt teaching: banded v4 pricing (five thresholds spelled out) + delivery. Pairs with @gemmein/sdk 0.4.0. Built from dev repo 4590a88, verify gate green (350 security / 31 apps / package gates / boundaries), ledger 110 entries 0 drift.

THE AI-FIRST FUNNEL (docs/DIRECTION-AI-FIRST.md, sealed 1 Aug): the founder's AI is the customer. init is RETIRED to a signpost (exit 0, points at dev + llms.txt; the terminal interview is gone — the business questions move to the founder's own AI chat). `gemmein dev` boots in an EMPTY directory: setup mode teaches the config shape on the boot card, the reconcile loop notices gemmein/gemmein.config.json appearing and says the app is ready on restart. Every printed instruction is npx-true (29 sites + static gate). GET / on the local API orients humans instead of refusing them. llms.txt is rewritten as the front door: FIT protocol first (fits / fits-except / doesn't, idea- and built-stage, verdict before any install or account), then Getting started (AI-run, human-answered); hardened by a blind-agent run (payouts/revenue-splits named out-of-scope, keyed-create scope documented collection-wide, unpaid-claim expiry honesty, config key list with the sells union). Pairs with the landing paste-prompt. Built from dev repo e686b74, verify gate green (357 security / 31 apps / 16 package incl. carve-boundary scan on this bundle), ledger 112 entries 0 drift.

Parity catch-up after the console overhaul (18-22 Aug). ENGINE: the CORS fix the 0.4.0 artifact missed — browser writes carrying x-collection-intent no longer die in preflight locally (57f2de8, shipped to prod 2 Aug, never promoted); plans and products unlock collections by NAME (keys minted at create as access:<slug>, stable through rename, Unlocked-by is an OR set, 403 entitlement_required narrows to ONE `requires` key, d25b967/0f24620); support inbox + replies on the local twin with the same words and ceilings as the cloud (W5.2 core + 20 review fixes); email domain ownership + verified-origin law + go-live gate (W8, e4ef61c); one envelope for every send — From word@apex, Reply-To on the receiving host only while receiving is verified, reply+ never in a header (21-22 Aug rulings). LLMS.TXT: rewritten for plans-by-name — teaches err.requires as one string, offers plans by name through checkout never a key list; byte-identical to @gemmein/sdk 0.4.1 (published 22 Aug). Built from dev repo 77168c2 (code = prod train 06fe853, tag v20260822-06fe853); verify gate green, ledger 117 entries 0 drift 0 stale, two adversarial review passes (entitlements, email arc) fixed before this build. Shim 0.4.1 alongside: version pin + hashes only.

The queue release (22 Aug 2026, Adil's ruling: sort the queue before anything new). ENGINE: locks can now be SET locally — a collection declaration gains `unlockedBy: [plan/product names]` (never keys), resolved through the same key ladder as the cloud; gemmein dev applies it on create and on file change, refuses an unknown name out loud, and re-applies once payments.json catches up; `gemmein check` signs in a free test member and checks that each lock holds (403 entitlement_required with the plan's key), fires for product-only apps, and never prints 'All boundaries hold' over an open paywall; sync carries Unlocked by as names and reports a cloud/local lock mismatch. Pay-sim fix: a simulated PLAN purchase never granted the plan's key (the sim event carried no customer) — now a stable per-buyer sim customer derived from the ref's email. Zero-field seal: a shape-enforced collection with nothing learned (or every field removed) is never sealed shut — skipped at both promotion doors and named in the result with the reason. Terms stamp: first consent wins on both planes (parity with the 22 Aug cloud fix). LLMS.TXT: teaches unlockedBy in the console's words; byte-identical to @gemmein/sdk's. Built from dev repo 408164a (prod train v20260822-408164a); verify gate green (432 security / 31 apps / 17 package incl. carve-boundary scan), ledger 121 entries 0 drift 0 stale, two adversarial review passes fixed before this build, cold boot in an empty dir proven. Shim 0.4.2: version pin + hashes only.

W7.1a — founder alerts + the grace window (Adil's 23 Aug rulings). ENGINE: ceilings are a notification and a grace window, never a wall — people-driven ceilings never refuse; the first crossing per category per period records an alert (CEILING-2); storage admits up to 2x its ceiling and refuses past it. The founder-alert primitive (ALERT-1: dedupe law, stale-claim reclaim, critical kinds always on) rides the local engine and PRINTS alerts in the gemmein dev terminal the way sign-in codes print (band_outgrown, inbox_waiting, billing_failed, domain_broke, storage_full). The send adapter (W7.1 A) is minted; OTP path untouched. LLMS.TXT: the limits paragraph now says ceilings never refuse and next month bills the band you grew into; byte-identical to @gemmein/sdk's. Built from dev repo 9d8f1d0 (prod train v20260823-9d8f1d0); verify legs green (452 security / 31 apps / 17 package incl. carve-boundary scan), ledger 124 entries 0 drift 0 stale, two adversarial reviews + a fix pass before this build, cold boot in an empty dir proven. Shim 0.4.3: version pin + hashes only.

FILE-2 + INBOX-START-1 (quick-closes #2 and #1 from the 23 Aug market research, both through the adversarial review pass). ENGINE: user uploads admit documents — pdf/zip/epub alongside the five image formats, 25MB per file (was 10MB images-only); one magic-byte proof for every collection (proveFileType); presign pins a server-built, policy-conditioned `attachment; filename=…` so a document downloads under its own name and an uploader can neither add nor change a disposition; the local dev shelf serves the pinned disposition + nosniff + sandbox CSP exactly as the prod CDN does, and the dev sink stores the policy-pinned FIELD content-type as S3 does; an empty declared type is named as the cause in the 415. Product files unchanged (audio, 100MB). INBOX-START-1 rides the internal plane (carved out of this artifact) — the local engine sees only its store parity. llms.txt: the files paragraph teaches documents, the 25MB cap, attachment-only delivery, {contentType} for bare Blobs.

W7.2 since-polling + watch() (research CLOSE #5, POLL-1) through two adversarial review passes. ENGINE: list gains ?since=<ISO 8601> — everything changed OR deleted after that instant, oldest change first, through the same rule switch and query scope as any read; tombstones cross as bare ids inside the caller's scope only; watermark minted from the store clock, lagged 2s (at-least-once: apply by id), rides every plain page and the final delta page; since+sort refused (400 invalid_since, strict ISO shape); tombstones exempt from where/search on deltas so a deletion reaches a filtered watcher; new records updated-at index. Request log gains delta traceability (delta/since/changed/deleted) and refusal codes. SDK: list({since}), ListResult.deleted/watermark, and watch(cb,{every}) — explicit polling, 10s default 5s floor, hidden-tab sleep with full resync on focus, backoff honouring resetAt, single in-flight tick. llms.txt: the Live data section (REPLACE on initial, filtered-watch caveat, never a tight loop).

W7.3 notify (NOTIFY-1) through two adversarial lenses, a whole-diff final review, and an end-to-end audit-traceability pass. ENGINE: POST /server/notify — an app's SERVER emails one of ITS OWN verified people (secret key only; person id, never an address; one 404 for missing/cross-env/suspended). Classified: event-class capped 5/person/day, account-class exempt (a security notice never loses to order emails), both under 200/app/hour with resetAt; failed sends and lost dedupe races refund their cap units. Person-scoped dedupe key = at-most-once through retries (idempotent answer before caps; in-flight twin answers 409 in_flight). The ruled footer sentence rides every send; no unsubscribe link BY RULING (receipts-class). Sends land as Inbox threads; replyRail in the response states whether replies actually land there. Every send attributable to its secret key (row + audit + log). Local engine prints NOTIFY · … instead of mailing. watch() now stops on 401/403 (a denied watcher polled and audited forever). SDK: gemmeinServer().notify(personId, {subject, text, kind?, key?}). llms.txt teaches the verb, the caps, the account-class deal, events-not-campaigns.

W7.4 FILE-AUDIENCE + W7.5/W7.5b file kind & class, each through the full gate chain (two adversarial lenses, whole-diff final reviews, walked proofs on both rails). ENGINE: a file may name ONE person besides its owner who may read it — upload(blob, {for: userId}) on addressed/direct collections stamps the recipient at birth, immutable; the direct message's attachment works; erasing the audience clears the grant, never the file; every sealed mint logs WHICH authority admitted it (owner|audience|back_office|purchase|rule). Shapes learn FILE as a first-class kind (strict-ref promotion, junk never demotes, NO maxLength — kills the 41-char ref vs text-40 seal landmine) AND its CLASS (image|document, resolved from the real upload; seen-both is sticky 'any'); locked file fields verify the ref names a CONFIRMED, readable file of the right class — one no-leak 'file not found' (400 unknown_file) for missing/foreign/unconfirmed/unreadable, and the class teach ('takes an image, not a document') as 400 invalid_shape. SDK: upload({for}); llms teaches the file kind, the class law, and the client-portal + direct-attachment recipes.

W7.6 FILE-LAW-2 (Adil's ruling: 'this is an universal thing — the shape doesn't matter') through the full gate chain: two adversarial lenses (both converged on the sticky-'any' brick — fixed: class is law only once the shape SEALS; pre-seal, learning owns class), whole-diff final review, walked on both rails. ENGINE: the file law is UNIVERSAL — any top-level ref-shaped value, on EVERY rule, locked or not, through both write doors (data plane + the console's internal plane), must name a real confirmed file the writer may hand (existence + hand-over rights; one shared no-leak refusal). The console door grandfathers values stored verbatim (a dead file's leftover ref never blocks an unrelated save) and teaches in the founder's language ('points at a file this app doesn't have — clear the field or attach a new file'). Founder alerts send from alerts@gemmein.com (ruling), Reply-To hello@. llms.txt teaches the universal law + dangling-ref recovery + top-level scope honestly. Pairs with @gemmein/sdk 0.4.5 (REFERENCE.md catch-up: documents, since/watch, notify incl. recorded?, file audience+kind, purchases.mine, 4 new wire codes). Built from dev repo f28be69, verify gate static+509+31+17 green, ledger 131 entries 0 drift.

W5 Tier A — the migration door (final-desk item 2), folding in the never-promoted 0.4.9 blind-run remediation. ENGINE: promotion carries owner-approved ADDITIVE fields to a live sealed collection — one business question per field (blank, or a virtual default served to records that never wrote it, never backfilled); presence is a real invariant (reads, expand targets, create/update responses, where-coalesce, increment base) wherever the shape is enforced — one predicate; decisions cross the wire with a `was` offer-fingerprint (409 offer_changed if development changed the spec); CAS-guarded seals on both rails (a PG-only birth-seal CAS regression that would have born production UNLOCKED was caught by the two-rails leg); a reversibility door changes/clears only a default. JavaScript built-in names (constructor, toString, __proto__…) refused as field AND collection names at every door — a pre-existing sealed-shape write bypass closed by class, not by site. Two adversarial lenses, then a three-reviewer full review; every new test mutation-proven (sha256), incl. the real-CLI↔real-server leg. llms.txt teaches the door, virtual defaults (writing null clears back), the built-ins refusal, and repoints the invalid_shape sentence off its dead end. Pairs with @gemmein/sdk 0.4.7 (docs-only). Built from dev repo 675f929 (sdk bump dc8b5bd); npm run verify green; ledger 142 entries, 0 drift.

The compute gate: verifySession / holdings / grantAccess / revokeAccess on the server plane, per-key capabilities, secret-key usage ledger; session refusals name the reason; the local key holds both capabilities.

Relays: receiver (any provider that signs its webhooks), schedule and record-change triggers running Gemmein's own verbs — write a record, grant or revoke access, email the person, call your URL — durable, retried, replayable; the invite door (POST /server/people); loud list limits (invalid_limit); x-client-info on every SDK call; the seventh grant source, relay.
